summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement on October 1, 2026 for a $[blank] offering of 7.00% senior fixed rate 10-year callable notes due October 20, 2036, priced at $1,000 per note (100%). Interest is paid semi-annually each April and October starting April 20, 2027, with optional issuer redemption beginning October 20, 2029. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with other senior unsecured debt. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, with Jefferies LLC as agent under FINRA Rule 5121. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation.
